payload.name: Concrete superiority effect in aging
payload.fact: Older adults do not benefit from the concrete superiority effect in high-imagery value word conditions, unlike young adults.
payload.boundary: Free recall task following learning of abstract words, concrete words, and pictures in older versus young adults.
